handbookNote: Virginia Real Estate Salesperson license exam. RECONSTRUCTED CONFIG: this track's original build session did not leave a local track-config/questionsDir on this machine -- the 105 live questions existed only in D1. For this pool-depth backfill pass (2026-08-31), the 105 live questions were exported directly from D1 and split by their existing 'topic' column into 4 bucket files under va_re_salesperson_questions/ (Agency Definitions & Brokerage Relationships 30, Disclosure Requirements/Advertising & Recordkeeping 21, Licensing/Qualifications/Continuing Education & Escrow Accounts 30, Virginia Fair Housing Law & Prohibited Acts 24) to serve as inventory/style reference for backfill agents. Regulatory framework: Virginia real estate licensees are regulated by the Virginia Real Estate Board (REB), part of the Department of Professional and Occupational Regulation (DPOR) -- governing statute is the Code of Virginia Title 54.1, Chapter 21 (SS 54.1-2100 et seq., 'Real Estate Brokers, Real Estate Salespersons, and Common Interest Community Managers'), with implementing regulations at 18VAC135-20 (Virginia Real Estate Board Regulations). This track_registry entry (exam_question_count=40, pass_percent=75, min_correct=30) reflects the Virginia-specific portion of the salesperson exam. Bucket agents should independently verify current exam vendor (commonly PSI for Virginia, but NOT yet confirmed this session), exact statute/regulation section numbers, and current item counts via live fetch of law.lis.virginia.gov (Code of Virginia) and the DPOR/REB website (dpor.virginia.gov) rather than assuming. Price set at $29.99 (2999 cents) to match this project's standardized Real Estate track rate. Backfill new-question IDs use prefix 'va_re_salesperson-deepen1-*', which will not collide with the original IDs already in D1.
